appName.description: Name of the MuleSoft application to upgrade.

environment.description: Anypoint environment to upgrade the application in.

jiraTicketId.description: Optional Jira ticket ID to link this migration to.

approvedChangePlan.description: Optional, audit-only. Recorded on the job record; the worker re-runs assessment and drives edits from its own fileEdits.

mode.description: Commit mode: "api" (GitHub Git Data API, default) or "local" (git/gh over a clone).

repo.description: GitHub repository override (used only when the app is not in the registry).

headSha.description: Repo HEAD at assess time (stale-plan anchor).

owner.description: GitHub owner/org override (used only when the app is not in the registry).

appPath.description: Path to the Mule module within the repo (e.g. "." for repo root).

orgId.description: Anypoint organization ID override (registry/convention fallback otherwise).

branch.description: Explicit branch. Highest precedence over registry default / discovered default.

versionStrategy.description: How to pin connector versions. "min" (default) = the curated Java-17-safe matrix pin; "first-compatible" = the lowest version marked Java-17-safe in the connector's release-notes OpenJDK table (the minimum upgrade — may sit below the matrix pin by explicit opt-in); "in-major" = highest published patch within the matrix pin's major (never crosses a breaking major); "latest" = latest published overall (may be a breaking major — verify); "manual" = use connectorSelections per connector, falling back to the matrix pin. See resolve_versions for the menu.

connectorSelections.description: Per-connector version overrides keyed by artifactId (e.g. {"mule-salesforce-connector":"10.19.2"}). Applied when versionStrategy is "manual"; a connector absent here falls back to the curated matrix pin.

deployedApiName.description: Exact deployed application name in Anypoint Runtime Manager to look up (matched VERBATIM). Reported on the assessment's deployedStateCheck; skipped with a reason when omitted, not configured, or not found. Non-fatal.

parentRef.description: CHAINED FLOW ONLY: when the app inherits from a shared parent-pom you just upgraded, pass its NEW version here so the app PR's FIRST commit repoints the app's <parent> to it (and the dry-run preview lists it) — no separate update_open_pr_parent_ref amend commit. The app's own pom is edited; emitted only if the app's <parent> matches and its version actually differs.

groupId.description: Parent groupId to match (optional; matched loosely when omitted).

toVersion.description: New parent version to set in the app's <parent> (e.g. 1.1.0-SNAPSHOT).

dryRun.description: When true, PREVIEW ONLY: run assessment and build the plan (fileEdits, connectorChoices, warnings, deployed-state) but do NOT acquire the app lock, apply any edit, create a job, or open a PR — nothing is written. Returns status PLAN_PREVIEW (or ALREADY_UPGRADED when there is nothing to change). The confirmation gate for an interactive agent: show the preview, then re-invoke with dryRun=false to execute. Default false.
